patches.before:
git rev-parse HEAD > "$output/head.txt"
          git archive HEAD | gzip > "$output/source.tar.gz"

          # The feature and target sides each have immutable native-source
          # reviews. Validate those exact parents separately, then require all
          # joined 59i successor reviews below on the current checkout.
          test "$(git rev-parse "$INTEGRATION_MERGE^2")" = "$TARGET_HEAD"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$INTEGRATION_MERGE" HEAD
          feature_native="/tmp/59i-native-feature-$SCALA_VERSION"
          target_native="/tmp/59i-native-target-$SCALA_VERSION"
          rm -rf "$feature_native" "$target_native"
          cleanup_native_worktrees() {
            git worktree remove --force "$feature_native" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            git worktree remove --force "$target_native" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          }
          trap cleanup_native_worktrees EXIT
          git worktree add --detach "$feature_native" "$INTEGRATION_MERGE^1"
          git worktree add --detach "$target_native" "$INTEGRATION_MERGE^2"
          (cd "$feature_native" && python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py) \
            | tee "$output/native-feature-parent.log"
          (cd "$target_native" && python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py) \
            | tee "$output/native-target-parent.log"
          (cd "$feature_native" && python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-native-source-overlay.py) \
            | tee "$output/overlay-feature-parent.log"
          (cd "$target_native" && python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-native-source-overlay.py) \
            | tee "$output/overlay-target-parent.log"
          cleanup_native_worktrees
          trap - EXIT

          for layer in 59i 59g 59h; do
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/run-parameterized-inherited-audit.py "morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-$layer-source-review.py" --self-test > "$output/$layer-source-self-test.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 100 "$output/$layer-source-self-test.log"; exit 1; }
patches.after:
git rev-parse HEAD > "$output/head.txt"
          git archive HEAD | gzip > "$output/source.tar.gz"

          # Both native-source parent certificates are enrolled in candidate provenance.
          test "$(git rev-parse "$INTEGRATION_MERGE^2")" = "$TARGET_HEAD"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$INTEGRATION_MERGE" HEAD

          for layer in 59i 59g 59h; do
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/run-parameterized-inherited-audit.py "morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-$layer-source-review.py" --self-test > "$output/$layer-source-self-test.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 100 "$output/$layer-source-self-test.log"; exit 1; }

          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
      - name: Compose sealed signedness closure with Increment 61
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-parameterized-integration-source.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-parameterized-integration-source.py --self-test
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-60f"
          predecessor="$output/predecessor-source"
patches.after:
ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
      - name: Consume authenticated candidate provenance
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 morphhdl/scripts/candidate_provenance_ci.py
      - name: Compose sealed signedness closure with Increment 61
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-parameterized-integration-source.py --self-test
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-60f"
          predecessor="$output/predecessor-source"

patches.before:
python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-equivalence-closure.py --self-test
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/run-parameterized-inherited-audit.py morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/run-parameterized-inherited-audit.py morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test
          base=$(python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --print-base)
          git worktree add --detach "$predecessor" "$base"
          trap 'git worktree remove --force "$predecessor"' EXIT
          (
            cd "$predecessor"
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-equivalence-closure.py --source-only
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-increment-60f-inherited-source-scope.py
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-equivalence-closure.py --self-test
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-wa07b-inherited-review.py
          )
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-artifacts.py self-test
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-58-retirement.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-production-retirement.py
patches.after:
python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-equivalence-closure.py --self-test
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/run-parameterized-inherited-audit.py morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/run-parameterized-inherited-audit.py morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test
          # The Increment 61 predecessor and its evidence are authenticated by the producer.
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-artifacts.py self-test
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-58-retirement.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-production-retirement.py

patches.before:
with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Syntax-check and self-test the exact native boundary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-parameterized-integration-source.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-parameterized-integration-source.py --self-test
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-parameterized-inherited-audit.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-increment-59i-inherited-audit-budgets.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-audit-git-batch.py
          test -x morphhdl/scripts/check-native-streamfifocc-boundary.sh
patches.after:
with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Authenticate candidate provenance once
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 morphhdl/scripts/candidate_provenance_ci.py --produce
      - name: Syntax-check and self-test the exact native boundary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-parameterized-integration-source.py --self-test
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-parameterized-inherited-audit.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-candidate-provenance.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-candidate-provenance-ci.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-increment-59i-inherited-audit-budgets.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-audit-git-batch.py
          test -x morphhdl/scripts/check-native-streamfifocc-boundary.sh

patches.before:
path: target/parameterized-inherited-audits
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
patches.after:
path: target/parameterized-inherited-audits
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Retain authenticated candidate provenance
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: candidate-provenance-${{ env.MORPHHDL_PROVENANCE_HEAD }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: target/parameterized-inherited-audits/candidate-provenance/receipt.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
